summary.zh: 用电热板加热一杯水并用温度计跟踪升温曲线，观察蒸汽与过热提示；移开热源后记录冷却过程，理解吸热与散热。
summary.en: Heat a beaker of water on a hotplate while tracking the temperature curve, watch steam and the overheat warning, then record the cool-down after removing the heat.

model_scope.zh: 集总热模型：水近似热容 4.18 J/(g·K)，环境散热按温差的固定比例每步进行；不模拟沸腾相变与对流细节。
model_scope.en: Lumped thermal model: water-like heat capacity 4.18 J/(g·K) and proportional cooling toward room temperature; boiling phase change and convection details are out of scope.

objective.zh: 用温度计测量烧杯中水的初始温度。
objective.en: Measure the starting temperature of the water.

hint_ladder.zh: 选中温度计，对烧杯做一次温度测量。
hint_ladder.en: Select the thermometer and take a reading of the beaker.

objective.zh: 把烧杯放到电热板上加热，观察温度上升与蒸汽出现；留意 60 °C 的过热提示。
objective.en: Heat the beaker on the hotplate; watch the temperature climb and steam appear, and note the 60 °C warning.

hint_ladder.zh: 加热命令：器材选电热板，目标是烧杯。
hint_ladder.en: Heat: the device is the hotplate, the target the beaker.

hint_ladder.zh: 可以边加热边测温，跟踪升温曲线。
hint_ladder.en: Measure while heating to follow the curve.

hint_ladder.zh: 接近 60 °C 会有过热提示；95 °C 会触发安全锁定。
hint_ladder.en: A warning appears near 60 °C; 95 °C triggers the safety lock.

objective.zh: 停止加热等待冷却，再测一次温度，比较前后读数。
objective.en: Stop heating, wait for cooling, then measure again and compare.

hint_ladder.zh: 等待一段时间让水向环境散热。
hint_ladder.en: Wait a while so the water loses heat to the room.

hint_ladder.zh: 温度越高降得越快——这是集总散热的特点。
hint_ladder.en: Hotter water cools faster — a feature of lumped cooling.

question.zh: 停止加热后，水温最可能怎样变化？
question.en: After the heat is off, the water temperature will most likely…

notes.zh: 60 °C 出现过热提示，95 °C 触发安全锁定；锁定后查看原因并从检查点或起点重来。
notes.en: Overheat warning at 60 °C and safety lock at 95 °C; after a lock, read the reason and restart from a checkpoint.
